# find_chemically_unique_cycles { #mofography.analyze.find_chemically_unique_cycles }

`analyze.find_chemically_unique_cycles(list_of_cycles, graph)`

> The function takes a list of cycles and a graph as input, and returns the indices of the unique
cycles in the list, after matching the 'element' of the nodes and the 'bond_order' of the edges

The function is a bit long, so let's break it down. 

First, we import the necessary libraries.

## Parameters

| Name             | Type   | Description                                     | Default    |
|------------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `list_of_cycles` |        | a list of cycles, each cycle is a list of nodes | _required_ |
| `graph`          |        | the graph object                                | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type   | Description                                             |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|
|        | The indices of the unique cycles in the list of cycles. |
